# scm_dlp_document_type (Data Source)

Retrieves details for an Enterprise DLP Document Type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a DLP document type by its ID.
data "scm_dlp_document_type" "example" {
  id = "REPLACE_WITH_ID"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the document type.

### Read-Only

- `category` (String) Category of the document type.
- `description` (String) A description of the document type.
- `detection_technique` (String) Detection technique.
- `l1_category_id` (Number) Level 1 Category ID.
- `l2_category_id` (Number) Level 2 Category ID.
- `name` (String) The name of the document type.
- `original_file_name` (String) Original sample file name.
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
